a.reden: The candidate finding describes a different issue than the known findings.

a.reden: The candidate describes the same missing fee deduction update prior to swap in the same function.

verdicts.title: onCall trusts message-supplied fromTokenAmount and mixSwap params, allowing draining of contract-held tokens

a.reden: Both findings describe a missing validation of the input token for a swap in the onCall function of GatewayTransferNative.sol.

b.reden: Both describe missing validation that params.fromToken matches the deposited zrc20 in GatewayTransferNative, letting an attacker swap arbitrary contract-held tokens using the deposited amount.

verdicts.title: GatewayCrossChain.onCall allows arbitrary fromToken swap to drain contract-held ZRC20

a.reden: Both describe a missing validation between swap output token and target withdrawal token in GatewayCrossChain.sol

b.reden: Both describe missing validation between swap fromToken and the deposited/withdrawal token in GatewayCrossChain.onCall, letting an attacker drain accumulated contract-held ZRC20s.
